onboarding.intro.title: Thank you for installing
onboarding.intro.reach: It connects websites to any wallet that supports openlv, whether that wallet runs on your phone, on your computer, or in another browser.
onboarding.intro.control: Your wallet stays in charge. It approves every signature, and a site only sees the accounts you choose.
onboarding.pin.title: Pin it to your toolbar
onboarding.pin.how: Click the puzzle piece next to the address bar, then the pin next to openlv-connect.
onboarding.pin.why: Its icon stays in your toolbar, so your wallets are one click away.
onboarding.pin.scene: The extensions menu next to the address bar, with the pin next to openlv-connect.
onboarding.pair.title: Connect a wallet
onboarding.pair.how: Open openlv-connect and select Connect. It shows a QR code and a link.
onboarding.pair.wallets: Scan the code with a phone wallet that supports openlv, or paste the link into one on your computer or in another browser.
onboarding.pair.scene: openlv-connect shows a QR code and a link. A phone wallet scans the code, a desktop wallet and a wallet in another browser take the link.
onboarding.site.title: Connect to a dApp
onboarding.site.ask: When a site asks for a wallet, openlv-connect opens a small window.
onboarding.site.pick: Pick the wallet and the accounts the site may see, then select Connect. Until you do, the site sees nothing.
onboarding.site.scene: A site asks to connect. The openlv-connect window lists your wallets and the accounts the site may see.
onboarding.sign.title: Approve in your wallet
onboarding.sign.where: Signatures and transactions go to your wallet, and you approve or reject them there.
onboarding.sign.never: openlv-connect never signs anything itself. With a hardware wallet, you also confirm on the device, as usual.
onboarding.sign.scene: The site asks for a signature. You approve it in your wallet on a phone, on a desktop with a hardware key, or in another browser.
onboarding.list.title: Manage your connections
onboarding.list.open: Open openlv-connect from the toolbar to see your wallets and the sites that use them.
onboarding.list.menu: The menu next to a wallet lets you revoke a site or forget the wallet.
onboarding.list.scene: The openlv-connect popup lists your wallets and the sites that use them.
onboarding.enjoy.title: Enjoy
onboarding.enjoy.done: You now know everything you need to use openlv. We hope you have a wonderful time.
